claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition S-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F01/F04/F09; type EXPLICIT; SUBJECTIVE/CLINICAL; THERAPEUTIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: MIXED / CONFLICTING. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

H26 GEE group coefficient p=.053 with 31.8 percent attrition

evidence_items.text: Lin et al. 2022: week-12 PSQI grounded 0.3 plus/minus 0.7 (n=8) versus control 3.0 plus/minus 1.9 (n=7), Mann-Whitney p=.006.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The strongest controlled sleep signal located; a pointwise comparison in 15 completers.

evidence_items.text: Park et al. 2025: actigraphy signal reported, but the prose points to day 31 while a parenthetical says 'Day 38: p<.01, t=3.5'; absolute values are absent.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A positive objective signal whose measurement timepoint is internally contradictory and is left unresolved; it cannot be assigned by inference.

evidence_items.text: Ghaly & Teplitz 2004 (uncontrolled n=12), Chevalier et al. 2019 (16 massage therapists) and Kim 2020 (observational mat users) report subjective sleep improvement; H33 reports a secondary sleep time-by-group F=7.53, p=.008.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Additional narrow signals, each uncontrolled, self-selected, one dataset, or confounded by a combined barefoot walking programme.

evidence_items.text: Park et al. 2025 day-31 between-group results: ISI p=.275, PSQI p=.562, ESS p=.962, BEPSI p=.756.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The most complete set of prespecified between-group sleep comparisons in the substrate is uniformly null.

evidence_items.text: Lin et al. 2022 GEE group coefficient B=-1.407, SE=.7278, 95 percent Wald CI -2.834 to .019, p=.053; attrition 7/22 (31.8 percent); registration posted February 2022 for a trial completed July 2020.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The model-based estimate does not reach significance and is not a group-by-time interaction; retrospective registration cannot secure prespecification.

evidence_items.text: Park et al. 2025 participant-flow conflicts: 60 stated, three exclusions stated, 56 analysed, text 26/30 versus Table 3 30/28; baseline ISI 7.6 plus/minus .7 versus 12 plus/minus 1.2, p<.001.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Denominator contradictions and a large baseline imbalance prevent a stable effect estimate.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Evidence exists on both sides and no stable decisive effect estimate survives the reporting conflicts.
supporting: H33 secondary sleep time-by-group F=7.53, p=.008

detected.rationale: An established general effect is advertised while the most complete prespecified between-group comparisons were null and the strongest positive model estimate did not reach significance.
Signals from mild Alzheimer patients, 12 uncontrolled participants, 16 massage therapists and self-selected mat users are generalised to a general customer audience.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase; possible deferral of insomnia care.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That sleep improvement is an established, reliable effect of the product.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Sleep is the headline benefit and the most likely purchase driver; readers are unlikely to see the null results.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: A solid reading was considered: several controlled studies do report sleep benefit and the underlying evidence really is mixed rather than empty. It is rejected because the advertised wording reports the effect as established for a general audience while the largest set of prespecified between-group questionnaire comparisons was null.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — Steelman defended a real positive lean; the adversarial layer showed the prespecified comparisons are null. Resolved by verdicting the advertised certainty as overclaim while recording the evidence state as genuinely mixed rather than empty.
missing_evidence: H30 day-31 ISI p=.275, PSQI p=.562, ESS p=.962, BEPSI p=.756
H26 GEE group coefficient p=.053 with 31.8 percent attrition
H30 denominator and baseline conflicts; actigraphy timepoint contradiction unresolved
H33 sleep signal arises inside an inseparable combined programme
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: H30's actigraphy timepoint (day 31 versus day 38) is irreducibly contradictory in the source and is left unresolved; a registered, powered exact-product sleep RCT with co-primary endpoints does not exist.

verdict.verdict_summary: Sleep is the best-studied advertised outcome and the evidence genuinely points both ways. A 12-week pilot found a large pointwise PSQI difference but its model group coefficient was p=.053 with 31.8 percent attrition; a one-month double-blind trial found no day-31 difference on ISI, PSQI, ESS or perceived stress. Neither the advertised certainty nor a general-audience effect is established.
